notes: בְּנֵי הֶחָיִל → *valiantest* fuses under rule 30 across the intervening article, which takes the written *the*; the head is חַיִל, whose lexeme the one word writes.
לְפִי־חֶרֶב is split because the ASV spends *with* on the preposition and *edge* on the construct noun, so rule 30's condition is unmet.
The waw before the women takes the *with* written for it (rule 14, open list).
